overall_assessment: USN section extraction is largely correct: all seven sections land in the right place for the 18 plans, including learning outcomes with all three sub-groups and arbeidskrav separated from assessment. Remaining defects are cosmetic: Leganto UI text in reading_list, and sub-heading lines left in coursework_requirements and teaching_methods because every page goes through the text fallback.

findings.evidence: Click to view interactive reading list in LegantoObligatorisk litteratur
findings.description: reading_list holds the raw Leganto widget text: a campus/course-variant header, the Leganto link label glued onto the first heading, and per-item UI labels ("View online", "In compendium", item type prefixes such as "Book"/"Book Chapter" fused to titles). This is navigation/formatting noise, not reference text. In MG1PE3/MG2PE3 the header lists 5-6 campus variants (Drammen, Notodden, Porsgrunn, Vestfold), so the section is ~28k chars and appears to combine lists for several course codes.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The reading list is read from the Leganto embed as flat text, and .clean_sections() has no USN-specific cleanup for the widget labels.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a USN reading-list cleanup that strips the lines '^Click to view interactive reading list in Leganto' (and splits the glued section heading), '^View online$', '^In compendium$' and the leading item-type token (Book|Book Chapter|Article|Electronic Article|Document|Audio Recording) before the title; drop the campus-variant header lines or keep only the one matching the plan's course code.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk aktivitet og krav til tilstedeværelse
findings.description: The page has two requirement headings (Arbeidskrav and Obligatorisk aktivitet og krav til tilstedeværelse). Both correctly end up in coursework_requirements, but the second heading line, and sometimes a nested label ('Obligatorisk aktivitet', 'Krav til tilstedeværelse'), is left inside the text as a stray line instead of being a boundary.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: All USN pages are read via the text fallback ('no headings read from the page'), so the second heading of the same section is not recognised as a heading and is kept as body text.
findings.suggested_fix: Configure the USN section_* fields so headings are read from the page, or have the fallback drop a line that exactly matches a heading already mapped to the current section.

findings.evidence: Utgifter i forbindelse med ev. ekskursjoner betales av den enkelte student.
findings.description: The 'Utgifter i emnet' (course expenses) heading is unmapped, so its text is appended to coursework_requirements. Expenses are admin information, not an arbeidskrav.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No pattern for 'Utgifter i emnet' in R/section_heading_map.R, so text continues the previous section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map '^Utgifter i emnet' to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R.

findings.evidence: Se egen emneplan for praksis for en nærmere beskrivelse.
findings.description: The 'Praksis' sub-section is merged into teaching_methods together with its heading line ('Praksis'). The content (practice placement description/reference) is arguably a learning activity, so the placement is acceptable, but the heading word remains as a stray line inside the text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Praksis' is not a recognised heading in the text fallback, so it is not cut and not removed.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Praksis' to the heading map as teaching_methods (strip the heading line), or treat it as a sub-heading of Læringsaktiviteter.
